topic: how to pay with zelle chase
slug: how to pay with zelle chase

steps.narration: Open the Chase app and sign in.
Tap "Pay & transfer" on the bottom navigation bar.
Tap the recipient you want to pay, or tap "Add recipient" to add a new one.
Enter the amount, an optional message, and choose the account to pay from under "Pay from".
Check the recipient, amount, and delivery date on the review screen, then tap "Send money".
The confirmation screen shows your money is being sent, and the recipient will get it in a few minutes.
